decisions: Use one static HTML file with embedded CSS and no runtime dependencies.
Use semantic landmarks, responsive layout, descriptive in-page navigation, visible focus, and reduced-motion handling as design intentions.
Mark browser, keyboard, screen-reader, performance, and WCAG conformance checks UNVERIFIED because they were not executed.
Role names identify workflow responsibilities in one sequential assistant session; no independent subagent runtime was launched.

outcome.summary: The documented research-to-handoff pipeline and static page source are complete. Local shell/browser tests were unavailable; repository-level automated checks must be run in CI or a checkout.

notes: The GitHub connector does not expose per-call elapsed time; duration_ms=0 means not measured, not instantaneous. Timestamps bound the observed work window and are approximate session timestamps.
